cfallin opened PR #15230 from cfallin:fix-debug-gc-panic to bytecodealliance:main:

This fixes #14845, where GC tracing (which also traces debug state-slots) needs debug tags to know the state-slot shape at any callsite that might be on the stack; that includes libcalls that do GC allocations!

This PR first unifies libcall emission into a call_builtin helper, then attaches the appropriate tags to the generated call in that one place.
